Title: Retirement: Azure Maps Traffic APIs Version 1.0 to Be Retired on March 31, 2028

Body.Content:
The following Azure Maps Traffic APIs version 1.0 will be retired on March 31, 2028:


  • Get Traffic Flow Segment 

  • Get Traffic Flow Tile 

  • Get Traffic Incident Detail 

  • Get Traffic Incident Tile 

  • Get Traffic Incident Viewport 


Please transition to Azure Maps Traffic Incident API version 2025-01-01 and/or Azure Maps Get Map Tile API version 2024-04-01 by that date. From now to March 31, 2028, you can continue to use Azure Maps Traffic APIs version 1.0 without disruption. After March 31, 2028, Azure Maps Traffic APIs version 1.0 will no longer be available and/or supported, and API calls will fail. All other Azure Maps services are unaffected by this retirement announcement. 

Required action 

To avoid service disruptions, please stop usage of Azure Maps Traffic APIs version 1.0 by March 31, 2028. We encourage you to transition to Azure Maps Traffic Incident API version 2025-01-01 and/or Azure Maps Get Map Tile API version 2024-04-01 prior to the retirement date. Please review the migration instructions and transition before March 31, 2028.  More Information

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and need technical help, create a support request.
